propositions: RunawayPaginationError subclasses RuntimeError instead of BackendPaginationStallError, placing it outside the core stall hierarchy that fetcher's re-raise clauses match on

fetch_snapshot's three enrichment handlers (parent, comment, issuelink) catch BackendPaginationStallError to re-raise it past fail-opens, but miss Cloud's RunawayPaginationError, causing the broad except Exception beneath each to swallow it
A stalled Cloud pagination cursor produces a silently degraded snapshot with missing parents or issuelinks written as authoritative, instead of aborting the pass
The fix makes RunawayPaginationError inherit from BackendPaginationStallError so the three fetcher re-raise clauses cover it automatically while preserving RuntimeError in the MRO
Existing except RunawayPaginationError sites and except RuntimeError sites are unaffected by the inheritance change
Ordinary non-stall enrichment failures must continue to fail open and write degraded snapshots as a negative control
